description: Enqueue a turn on a persistent Claudexor thread with optional routing and strict account overrides. Supply idempotencyKey to recover a lost response without creating another paid turn. Returns durable thread and turn handles plus runId or a queued jobId.

effort.description: Optional effort override for this turn. Expects a reasoning-effort level the resolved harness/model advertises (a lowercase slug; each vendor lists its own levels, weakest to strongest); an advertised level is passed through as-is.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-owned key for one logical turn. Retry an unknown outcome with the same key and body; use a new key for an intentional next turn.

prompt.description: The next user turn for the persistent thread.

name: claudexor_thread_turn

anyOf.description: Response for a successfully enqueued run.

jobId.description: Daemon job id backing the run.

summary.description: Human-readable turn handle summary (same as the tool's text content).
Human-readable turn handle summary (same as the tool's text content).

outputSchema.description: Structured MCP result for claudexor_thread_turn: the durable thread-turn handle.
